subject: Next steps: technical deep-dive — please confirm a slot
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam@finapp.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@finapp.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: technical deep-dive — please confirm a slot

Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for your time today — good discussion on where FinApp is with embeddings and latency targets. Quick recap: you care most about (1) 99th percentile latency under 500ms for short prompts, (2) predictable per-request costs at scale, and (3) VPC deployment for regulated data. Marcus (cc'd) will run the technical deep-dive and sizing.

Proposed 60-minute deep-dive slots (PST):
- Tue May 26 — 10:00–11:00am
- Wed May 27 — 2:00–3:00pm
- Thu May 28 — 9:00–10:00am

If none work, please suggest two windows that fit your team's calendar and we'll lock one in. We prefer a tight confirmation (within 24 hours) so Marcus can prepare targeted benchmarks and bring the right infra notes.

Attached: Redwood-Platform-Overview.pdf and a placeholder calendar invite (deep-dive-invite.ics).

Agenda (draft):
- 5m intros & goals
- 15m architecture & current FinApp stack + constraints
- 25m live walkthrough: latency/cost trade-offs + demo of routing/fallbacks
- 10m next steps / POA

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: Redwood-Platform-Overview.pdf (pdf), deep-dive-invite.ics (calendar invite)

From: Sam Taylor <sam@finapp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@finapp.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: technical deep-dive — please confirm a slot

Vanessa — thanks for the recap. Helpful.

Quick note: the suggested Tue/Wed/Thu slots overlap with our sprint planning and an executive offsite. We can do one of the following instead:
- Mon May 25 — 11:00–12:00am (PST) — Sam / Priya / infra lead
- Fri May 29 — 1:00–2:00pm (PST) — smaller group (Sam + Priya)

If you need Marcus and a full team, Mon would be better for us. If Marcus is only available later, we can do Fri and then schedule a follow-up with SEs.

Also, can you share your proposed benchmark checklist beforehand so we can prep data extracts? Priya will own that on our side.

—Sam
Sam Taylor
Head of Platform Engineering | FinApp Inc
sam@finapp.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam@finapp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@finapp.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: technical deep-dive — please confirm a slot

Sam — perfect, appreciate the quick reply.

We can do Mon May 25 11:00–12:00 (PST) — Marcus confirmed that slot and will cover the benchmarks + sizing. I've attached an updated placeholder invite (deep-dive-invite.ics) and the preliminary agenda link: https://drive.redwood.ai/finapp/prelim-agenda.docx.

Two small asks to keep this tight and productive:
1) Can you confirm attendance for Sam, Priya, and your infra lead by EOD Friday (24 May)? We try to avoid no-shows since Marcus will prepare a live profile.
2) Priya — if you can upload the sample request traces (anonymized) to the drive link by EOD Friday that would let Marcus generate a pre-run profile.

If we don't hear back by Friday, we'll hold the slot but scale down the live demo and keep the session more of a product overview. Would you prefer we automatically move to Fri May 29 1:00–2:00pm instead if confirmation doesn't arrive? Reply with "AUTO-FRI" and we'll reschedule.

Thanks — locking this as tentative for now.

Best,
Vanessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments: deep-dive-invite.ics (calendar invite)

Subject: Re: Next steps: technical deep-dive — please confirm a slot

Thanks all — Marcus here. I'll run the session Monday and will prepare a short runbook. Two quick items from my side:
- Agenda tweak: please allocate ~10 minutes at the top for an infra diagram (so we can map network/VPC constraints).
- Data ask: if you can only share a single sample, prioritize 1) a 99th-percentile trace for short prompts and 2) an average token distribution CSV.

I'll post the runbook link before EOD Sunday and bring a simple latency heatmap demo. Looking forward to it.

—Marcus
